ModMetaData.name: Vanilla Combat Overhaul
ModMetaData.author: cruesoe
ModMetaData.description:
Adds depth to RimWorld's combat without replacing it.
MELEE - Pawns can parry incoming attacks, and a good parry opens a counter-attack. - Hits from the side or behind do more damage. - Being outnumbered makes you easier to hit. - Attacks aim where the attacker can reach - a short pawn is not swinging at a tall one's head.
RANGED - Shooting skill matters more, and the gap between a good shot and a bad one is wider. - Moving targets are harder to hit than standing ones. - Missed shots go wide of the target rather than landing anywhere nearby, and spread further at long range. - Bullets and arrows wound differently - bullets by force, arrows by cutting deep. - Projectiles leave a short glowing trail, so you can see where fire is coming from.
ARMOUR - Armour that fails to stop a hit still reduces it, instead of the all-or-nothing vanilla roll. - Weapon armour penetration is shown on the weapon.
EQUIPMENT - Colonists automatically choose and upgrade their primary weapon using their skills and assigned policy. - Manually equipped weapons remain locked until you allow automatic upgrades again.
CLOTHING - Gloves and boots protect hands and feet. Masks, helmets and glasses cover the face properly.
Combat and equipment systems can be configured individually in the mod settings.
Not compatible with Auto Arm, Combat Extended, Yayo's Combat, or Vanilla Combat Reloaded.
